name: Landhaus Schöpf
beschreibung: Landhaus Schöpf welcomes vacationers to a quiet, sun-drenched hillside location on the edge of Telfs in Tyrol's upper Inn Valley, directly beneath the prominent Hohe Munde peak (2,662 m). The property offers modern, tastefully appointed self-catering apartments with fully equipped kitchens, inviting living areas, and expansive balconies or terraces framing panoramic vistas across the Inn Valley. A manicured garden lawn provides peaceful outdoor relaxation. Centrally located between Innsbruck and the sunny Mieming Plateau, championship golf courses, scenic trailheads, the Telfer Bad leisure pools, and Seefeld's ski resorts are all just minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Modern holiday apartments in Telfs at the foot of the Hohe Munde mountain in the upper Inn Valley.
